title: DOUBLE_SPEND / REPLAY_ATTACK: calling refund/complete twice may pay out twice

inferred_invariant.statement: Total returned to the customer (order.totalReturned) must never exceed the order's original amount (order.originalAmount = 100), even if POST /api/order/refund/complete is called a second time after the refund already completed. UIR-002 shows the 'Complete refund' button and availableActions.completeRefund both disappear after the first completion, implying the workflow intends completion to happen exactly once; this must be enforced server-side, not just hidden in the UI.
